process_issues.description: The reviewer briefs gave the PR's restored config copies as `.claude-pr/skills/...`, but the action keeps them at `.claude-pr/.claude/skills/...`. All three reviewers lost a few reads before they found the right path (context also used `git show` on the head). Every reviewer still read the PR's versions in the end.

I did not spawn correctness, security, simplicity or guards. The PR only changes markdown skill prose under `.claude/`: it has no logic, no trust boundary, no new code constructs and no source a guard test scans. Spec did not run because the PR closes no issues. It cites only a spike doc's task IDs.

The context reviewer did not read `.github/workflows/*` to check for workflows gating on the `feature`, `ready` or `design-approved` labels. It also did not confirm the `pup launch` refusal conditions. The docs reviewer did confirm those conditions (`NO_ROOM_ERRORS` in `src/cli/index.ts`).
